type Vec = { x: number; y: number; z: number };

export interface ChaseCamera {
    camera: FreeCamera;

}

export function createChaseCamera(eye: Vec, target: Vec): ChaseCamera {
    // Create the camera using the banked free camera factory
    // (which extends FreeCamera and has a mutable upVector)
    const camera = createBankedFreeCamera(eye, target, { x: 0, y: 1, z: 0 });
    
    // Store the current up vector for use in degenerate cases
    let currentUp: Vec = { x: 0, y: 1, z: 0 };
    
    return {
        camera,
        bank(up: Vec) {
            // Compute forward direction
            const dx = target.x - eye.x;
            const dy = target.y - eye.y;
            const dz = target.z - eye.z;
            const len = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);
            
            if (len < 1e-8) return; // eye and target are the same
            
            const fx = dx / len;
            const fy = dy / len;
            const fz = dz / len;
            
            // Check if up is parallel to forward (degenerate case)
            const dot = up.x * fx + up.y * fy + up.z * fz;
            
            if (Math.abs(dot) > 1 - 1e-6) {

                return;

            const py = up.y - dot * fy;
            const pz = up.z - dot * fz;

            if (pLen < 1e-8) return;

            const uy = py / pLen;
            const uz = pz / pLen;
            
            // Set the camera's up vector

            camera.upVector.y = uy;
            camera.upVector.z = uz;
            
            currentUp = { x: ux, y: uy, z: uz };
        }
    };
}
